description: Solve any percentage problem: find X percent of Y, find what percent X is of Y, or calculate the percentage increase or decrease between two numbers.

faqs.a: Use 'X is what % of Y' with X = 30 and Y = 200 to get 15%.
faqs.q: How do I find the percentage of a number like 30 of 200?

faqs.a: Increase is (new-old)/old x 100. Decrease is (old-new)/old x 100, shown as a negative or labeled decrease.
faqs.q: What is the formula for percentage increase?

faqs.a: Yes. The 'Increase / Decrease' mode handles negative results, e.g. going from 50 to 30 is a 40% decrease.

howto: Pick a mode: percent of, what percent, or increase/decrease.
Enter the two numbers for that mode.
The result calculates instantly as you type.
Switch modes anytime; each keeps its own inputs.
title: Percentage Calculator
